answer: Forge-Chained Attestation DAG. Each identity must forge signed attestations that cite the prior attestation hashes of every counterparty in its history. Since the citation graph is a DAG, a clone asserting independence must cite roots it cannot produce without colliding with its origin’s recorded edges. The resulting spiral of pointers makes duplicated histories self-revealing at audit. A sybil must fabricate an entire divergent nebula of valid linked history per clone, paying full re-attestation cost each time.
